name: Among the Faithful
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
narrative.objectives: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 8, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Infiltrating the Cult
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

quests.name: Falaath Village
quests.objectiveText: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

quests.name: Among the Faithful
quests.objectiveText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

quests.name: Havoc in the Highlands
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

quests.name: To Valanaar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
